scientific.integrity: The archive problem statement and later center-line reduction were materially inspected in primary full text. The semiaxis formula and threshold are independently derived and replayed by the packaged checker; numerical scans are not used as universal proof.
limitations: Uniqueness is proved only among bisections by center lines; arbitrary nonlinear minimizing curves are not classified.
The theorem is specific to Euclidean ellipses.
Qualitative optimality of the standard ellipse bisection is prior work; the new contribution is the exact value, transition, and center-line direction proof.

title: Exact maximum-relative-diameter bisection of every ellipse
